mine_news.headline: Paul George: Three swipes vs. Chicago
mine_news.body: George produced 18 points (7-15 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 2-2 FT), six rebounds, eight assists and three steals across 27 minutes during Friday's 125-111 win over Chicago.

mine_news.headline: Ty Jerome: Questionable versus Kings
mine_news.body: Jerome (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.
